title: cert chain: pathLen constraint not checked in validate_chain
description: cert.rs validate_chain checks BasicConstraints.cA=true and KeyUsage.keyCertSign but does NOT check the pathLen constraint (RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9). An intermediate CA with pathLen=0 must not sign other CAs. If an attacker can obtain a cert signed by a trusted root with cA=true and pathLen=0, they can use it to chain further (past the limit) without detection. Trigger: multi-level chain where an intermediate has pathLen=0 and signs another intermediate.
